mapper.select: SELECT a.auction_id, a.title, i.file_url AS image FROM likelist l JOIN auction a ON l.auc_key = a.auction_id LEFT JOIN ( -- auction 별 대표 상품 하나만 선택 (예: prod_key가 가장 작은 것) SELECT auc_key, MIN(prod_key) AS rep_prod_key FROM product GROUP BY auc_key ) p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key LEFT JOIN ( -- 대표 상품의 대표 이미지(가장 빠른 등록일) 선택 SELECT prod_key, MIN(reg_date) AS min_regdate FROM file GROUP BY prod_key ) fi ON p.rep_prod_key = fi.prod_key LEFT JOIN file i ON i.prod_key = fi.prod_key AND i.reg_date = fi.min_regdate WHERE l.user_key = #{userKey}
